scope: Read-only analysis of all 15 governance pillars x 10 completion criteria. No cell is promoted and no active artefact is published.

method.evidence_rule: Only current evidence-index bindings with evidence_status REVIEWED are eligible; candidate overlap, source counts and lexical matches do not establish completion.
method.classification_rule: Proposed lanes and next actions are retained from the prior audited criterion triage; candidate sets are read from the current matrix. Criterion-relevant evidence counts are carried forward from that audited triage and are not treated as completion.
method.status_rule: SOURCE_GAP requires source discovery/taxonomy routing; PROPOSAL_READY means material is available for criterion-specific construction; EVIDENCE_READY marks a targeted extraction, audit, or navigation gap.
method.completion_rule: COMPLETE, HUMAN_REVIEW and APPROVED are never emitted. Each cell remains completion-prohibited until a reviewed release records criterion rationale, applicability, currentness, provenance, questions and navigation.
method.confidentiality: Only identifiers, hashes, locators/counts and status values are emitted; no source text, project answers or secrets are copied.
